content.comment_body: Hello everyone, is there an official Android application available for monitoring or controlling a [product_name] PLC?
The [company_name] [product_name] app is no longer available.
What alternatives exist for receiving notifications and monitoring a [product_name] PLC from an Android device?
You might want to consider using HMI Droid (idea-teknik.com).

analysis.insight_summary: User is searching for an official [company_name] solution to monitor and control a [product_name] PLC via Android devices. The primary insight is that there is no longer an official Android app from [company_name], which limits users' ability to manage [product_name] hardware remotely using mobile platforms. This highlights a gap between what users need and the product support currently available for Android devices.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects an official Android application from [company_name] that allows direct monitoring and notification functionalities for the [product_name] PLC.
